messages:
Zoe (CEO): Quick post-all-hands ask: can we get one-line partner-friendly updates for API / Console / Optimize + single top risk for each? Paste here by EOD.

Mara (Product): API: limited preview next week—better auth and SDK consistency to ease integrations. Top risk: auth v2 rollout may cause brief reconnects for long-running streams.

Kevin L (Eng): Confirmed 10% canary; we'll monitor connection resets and have rollback ready.

Jess (Eng PM): Console: opt-in preview for route analytics and a streamlined onboarding flow in June. Top risk: telemetry schema v2 needs cross-team sign-off.

Alex (Optimize): Optimize: preview of automated batching/cache recommendations to reduce per-token cost. Top risk: need explicit opt-out for customers who don’t want auto-suggestions.

Sam (Docs): I'll draft partner-friendly bullets and a short FAQ about opt-in/opt-out by tomorrow AM.

Riley (SRE): Infra note: we're validating a zero-blip auth rollout; if validation fails we'll delay to avoid customer impact.

Ops (Release): Please add FINAL_SIGNOFF to tickets by Friday so we can lock canary windows.

Mara (Product): I'll bundle the one-liners + risks and tag Zoe once Sam posts the partner copy.

Zoe (CEO): Thanks—concise and benefits-first. If any canary flags appear, ping me immediately here. :thumbsup:
